entries.title: Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
entries.summary: The ECM sees misfire activity across more than one cylinder or cannot isolate it to a single cylinder.
firstChecks: Monitor misfire counters on live data

entries.title: Cylinder 1 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 1.

entries.title: Cylinder 2 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 2.
firstChecks: Check for intake leak at runner 2

entries.title: Cylinder 3 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 3.
firstChecks: Compression test if swap does not move the code

entries.title: Cylinder 4 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 4.
firstChecks: Check fuel trim on that bank

entries.title: Cylinder 5 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 5.

entries.title: Cylinder 6 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 6.

entries.title: Cylinder 7 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 7.

entries.title: Cylinder 8 Misfire Detected
entries.summary: Combustion instability detected on cylinder 8.
firstChecks: Check fuel trim on that bank

entries.title: Mass or Volume Air Flow (MAF) Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: MAF reading is outside expected range for current engine conditions.
firstChecks: Compare MAF g/s to MAP/VE at idle
Inspect boot between MAF and throttle body

entries.title: Mass or Volume Air Flow (MAF) Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: MAF signal voltage or frequency is lower than expected.
firstChecks: Back-probe MAF signal at idle and snap throttle
Compare to known-good sensor if available

entries.title: Mass or Volume Air Flow (MAF) Circuit High Input
entries.summary: MAF signal is higher than the calibrated range.
firstChecks: Inspect for oil contamination on hot wire

entries.title: Mass or Volume Air Flow (MAF) Circuit Intermittent
entries.summary: MAF signal is intermittent or drops out.

entries.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit Malfunction
entries.summary: MAP/BARO sensor circuit has an electrical fault.

entries.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: MAP sensor reading is outside expected range for operating conditions.
firstChecks: Inspect hose and ports for leaks/blockage

entries.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: MAP voltage is lower than expected.
firstChecks: Measure voltage at sensor with key on

entries.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit High Input
entries.summary: MAP voltage is higher than the expected range.

entries.title: Manifold Absolute Pressure/Barometric Pressure Circuit Intermittent
entries.summary: MAP sensor signal is intermittent or drops out.

entries.title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Malfunction
entries.summary: IAT sensor circuit has an electrical fault.

entries.title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: IAT sensor reading is inconsistent or outside expected range.
firstChecks: Graph IAT and compare to ambient

entries.title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: IAT voltage is lower than the minimum threshold.

entries.title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit High Input
entries.summary: IAT voltage is higher than the maximum threshold.

entries.title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Intermittent
entries.summary: IAT sensor signal is intermittent or drops out.

entries.title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Malfunction
entries.summary: ECT sensor circuit has an electrical fault.

entries.title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: ECT reading does not match expected engine operating temperature.

entries.title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: ECT voltage is lower than the minimum threshold.

entries.title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit High Input
entries.summary: ECT voltage is higher than the maximum threshold.

entries.title: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: TPS A reading does not match expected correlation with pedal or secondary sensor.
firstChecks: Graph TPS vs APP on scan tool

entries.title: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: TPS A voltage is lower than the minimum expected.

entries.title: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A Circuit High Input
entries.summary: TPS A voltage is higher than the maximum expected.

entries.title: Coolant Thermostat (Coolant Temperature Below Thermostat Regulating Temperature)
entries.summary: Engine coolant is not reaching operating temperature in the expected time.
firstChecks: Verify warm-up time on live ECT
Replace thermostat if engine runs cool
Check ECT sensor vs IR gun

entries.title: Coolant Temperature Below Thermostat Regulating Temperature (Too Long to Warm Up)
entries.summary: Engine taking too long to reach operating temperature.
firstChecks: Check warm-up time on live data

entries.title: Coolant Thermostat (Coolant Temperature Below Thermostat Regulating Temperature)
entries.summary: Engine coolant is not reaching operating temperature in the expected time.
firstChecks: Verify warm-up time on live ECT
Replace thermostat if engine runs cool
Check ECT sensor vs IR gun

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: Upstream O2 sensor signal is missing or out of range.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: O2 sensor is stuck at high voltage or responding incorrectly.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: O2 sensor is responding too slowly to mixture changes.
firstChecks: Monitor sensor response time to throttle snap

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit (No Activity)
entries.summary: O2 sensor shows no switching activity.
firstChecks: Scope signal pin at idle and load

entries.title: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: Upstream O2 heater on bank 1 is not drawing expected current.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
entries.summary: Downstream O2 sensor signal is missing or erratic.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
entries.summary: Downstream O2 sensor is stuck at low voltage.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
entries.summary: Downstream O2 sensor is stuck at high voltage.
firstChecks: Verify heater off when engine off

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit (No Activity)
entries.summary: Downstream O2 sensor shows no switching.

entries.title: O2 Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
entries.summary: Downstream O2 heater circuit fault on bank 1.
firstChecks: Swap test only if OEM allows
Check voltage supply with key on
Replace sensor if heater resistance is open

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: Bank 2 upstream O2 sensor signal is missing or out of range.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit High Voltage (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: Bank 2 O2 sensor is stuck at high voltage.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: Bank 2 O2 sensor responds slowly to mixture changes.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2 Sensor 1)
entries.summary: Bank 2 upstream O2 heater is not drawing expected current.

entries.title: Oxygen Sensor Heater Circuit Malfunction (Bank 2 Sensor 2)
entries.summary: Bank 2 downstream O2 heater circuit fault.
firstChecks: Check voltage supply with key on

entries.title: Fuel Trim System Malfunction (Bank 1)
entries.summary: Bank 1 fuel trim adaptation is at its limit and cannot correct the mixture.

entries.title: System Too Lean (Bank 1)
entries.summary: Oxygen sensor reports excess oxygen on bank 1 — more air or less fuel than expected.
firstChecks: Inspect intake boots and vacuum lines
Compare MAF grams/sec to spec at idle

entries.title: System Too Rich (Bank 1)
entries.summary: Too little oxygen reported on bank 1 — excess fuel or restricted air.
firstChecks: Look for black smoke or fuel smell

entries.title: Fuel Trim System Malfunction (Bank 2)
entries.summary: Bank 2 fuel trim adaptation has reached its limit.

entries.title: System Too Lean (Bank 2)
entries.summary: Oxygen sensor reports excess oxygen on bank 2.

entries.title: System Too Rich (Bank 2)
entries.summary: Too little oxygen detected on bank 2 — excess fuel or restricted air.

entries.title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction
entries.summary: Fuel pressure sensor signal is missing or out of range.

entries.title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: Fuel pressure sensor reading is erratic or outside normal range.

entries.title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: Fuel pressure sensor voltage is lower than minimum.

entries.title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor Circuit High Input
entries.summary: Fuel pressure sensor voltage is higher than maximum.

entries.title: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder 1)
entries.summary: Injector 1 control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder 2)
entries.summary: Injector 2 control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder 3)
entries.summary: Injector 3 control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder 4)
entries.summary: Injector 4 control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder 5)
entries.summary: Injector 5 control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Injector Circuit Malfunction (Cylinder 6)
entries.summary: Injector 6 control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Pump Primary Circuit Malfunction
entries.summary: Fuel pump power control circuit is open, shorted, or has no signal.

entries.title: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit Low
entries.summary: Fuel pump secondary circuit voltage is too low.

entries.title: Fuel Pump Secondary Circuit High
entries.summary: Fuel pump secondary circuit voltage is too high.

entries.title: Turbo/Super Charger Overboost
entries.summary: Boost exceeded the maximum allowed limit.

entries.title: Turbo/Super Charger Underboost
entries.summary: Boost pressure did not reach the target for the given load.
firstChecks: Pressure test charge pipes and intercooler
Check boost solenoid and vacuum lines

entries.title: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1 or Single Sensor)
entries.summary: Knock sensor signal is missing or out of range.
likelyCauses: Excessive engine noise misread as knock
firstChecks: Listen for mechanical knock or rod bearing noise

entries.title: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: Knock sensor signal is noisy or out of normal range.

entries.title: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit Low Input
entries.summary: Knock sensor signal voltage is too low.

entries.title: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit High Input
entries.summary: Knock sensor signal voltage is too high.

entries.title: Crankshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Malfunction
entries.summary: CKP signal is absent or erratic — engine may not start or stall.

entries.title: Crankshaft Position Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance
entries.summary: CKP sensor signal is erratic or out of normal range.

entries.title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit Malfunction (Bank 1)
entries.summary: CMP signal missing or out of sync with crank signal.
firstChecks: Verify timing marks if chain suspected

entries.title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit Range/Performance (Bank 1)
entries.summary: CMP signal is erratic or delayed compared to crank signal.

entries.title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit Low Input (Bank 1)
entries.summary: CMP sensor voltage is lower than minimum.

entries.title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit High Input (Bank 1)
entries.summary: CMP sensor voltage is higher than maximum.

entries.title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit Intermittent (Bank 1)
entries.summary: CMP sensor signal is intermittent or dropouts occur.
